description: Stop posting to an account and forget its sign-in. Its posts stay and anything still waiting to go out is held; what the network told us about it goes after 30 days, or within 7 for a YouTube channel, as YouTube asks. Connecting it again brings it back. Agents get a confirm_token step.

confirm_token.description: Token from a CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED response, sent after the user confirms.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

name: account_disconnect
title: Disconnect an account
